guide_passage:
The r4 guide's passage (the passage this carries):
One Intention in the Morning, One Review at Night

In the morning, choose one modest intention:

“Today I will notice one hook before I act from it.”

At night, review the day without conducting a trial:

Where did I notice the hook?

Where did it run the sequence anyway?

What small repair or protective act comes next?

What moment of warmth, pleasure, courage, or connection did I actually receive?

Count recognition as progress, even when it arrived afterward. If you interrupted the pattern, notice that too. Repair what can be repaired, renew the intention, and go to sleep.
note: Turn 65 (2026-10-17): Simple Practices, practice 6 of 9 (One Intention in the Morning, One Review at Night), for the dedup.
before: The story version is still true, and it's no proof you got every detail right. Listen to how the narrator sounds. A sneer means stop. So does more shame, or a feeling that you're not quite real, and stepping further back won't fix either one. If the line helps, leave it at one line (no epilogue needed).

brief:
- the main point: in the morning one modest intention ("Today I will notice one hook before I act from it."); at night a review that isn't a trial: where you noticed the hook, where it ran the sequence anyway, the next small repair or protective act, and the warmth, pleasure, courage or connection you received; count recognition as progress even when it came afterward; notice an interrupted pattern too; repair what can be repaired, renew the intention, sleep.
- what the dedup leaves to add (G6): the morning-intention, night-review routine; hook-noticing as the day's aim; the review questions (where you noticed, where it ran anyway, what good came); counting recognition that came only later; renewing the intention, then sleep.
- already in the article, so not said again: an interrupted pattern noticed ("I did that for us. That was the Protector."); "nobody's on trial" (B231) is already the article's phrase, so the night review says it another way.
